name: Swap Validator
description: Decides whether a move is a move, and rescues a board that has run out of them. A swap is legal only if it produces a match, which is the rule that makes the genre a puzzle rather than a fidget toy — and rejecting a swap has to be visible, so the rejection is an event and not a silent snap-back. The second job is the one players never see working: after every settle the validator counts remaining legal moves, and on zero it reshuffles rather than presenting a dead board. Reshuffling is announced, because a board that rearranges itself with no explanation reads as a bug. A hint is the same search stopped at the first result, which is why it lives here rather than in a separate component. The validator depends on world.match_resolver because it has to see the board to judge a swap, and the board belongs to the resolver.

inputs.name: requireMatchToSwap
inputs.description: Whether swaps that make no match are refused. False is the relaxed variant.

inputs.name: shuffleOnDeadlock
inputs.description: Whether a board with no legal move reshuffles rather than ending the level.

inputs.name: hintAfterIdleSeconds
inputs.description: Idle time before a legal move is suggested. 0 disables hints.

inputs.name: maxShufflesPerLevel
inputs.description: Reshuffles allowed before the level is declared unwinnable and ends honestly.

outputs.name: legalMoveCount
outputs.description: Legal swaps available on the current board.

outputs.name: suggestedMove
outputs.description: The move a hint would offer, or null.
